title: trisetum neglectum
intro: Trisetum neglectum, commonly known as Rough Blue Grass, is a perennial grass native to the eastern parts of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to relax the nervous system and reduce anxiety, which is attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of Trisetum neglectum may also have antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions.
